## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 632 reads during the review period. This work required 480 hours, giving an average throughput of 1.3 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review against the applicable expectations for the period. The figures provide a clear summary of activity completed and time spent, and will support consideration of the quality findings set out below.

## Quality

A sample of 51 reads was checked as part of the review. The agreement rate was 84.3 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the workload and throughput information above when assessing overall performance. The findings have been reviewed by Priya Anand. No further action is required for this period.
